| baptism for the dead | Baptism for the Dead | noun | Misite a dinga tui kiphumna. A sisa mi khat a dinga a damlai khat tui kiphumna hi. Hih pen Marcionte, Novatiante leh Mormonte sungah kizang hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism in jesus’ name | Baptism in Jesus’ Name | noun | Zeisu min tawh tuiphumna. Zeisu in vantung ah a kahtoh ding ciangin a nungzuite tungah vak kawikawi unla mi khempeuh ka nungzui na suahsakkhit uh ciangin Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism in the name of the father, son and spirit | Baptism in the Name of the Father, Son and Spirit | noun | Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphumna. Zeisu in tuiphumna thupi ngaihsut ahih manin amah zong Johan tungtawn in Jordan gun ah hong kiphum hi. Tuiphumna in Pasian ka um hi, Pasian ta ka suakzo | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism in water | Baptism in Water | noun | Tui sungah phumna. Tui sungah phumna leh diahna hi. Zeisu in mi khat a pianthak leh tui kiphum ding hong sawl hi. Tuiphumna pen thehna leh leihna hilo in pumpi bup tui sungah diahna hi. Pumpi bup kawt | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism of believers | Baptism of Believers | noun | Pasian thu a umte tui kiphumna. Tuiphumna in Pasian ta suahna hilo in thuzuite tawh kipumkhatna hi. Tuiphumna in upna lahna hi. Thukhun Lui sungah Judah mite sunga pasalno khempeuh vun ki-at hi. Thukh | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism of blood, the | Baptism of Blood, the | noun | Kithahna sisan in tuiphumna. Pasian min tawh bawlsiatna thuakna tawh thahna tungtawn a luangkhia sisan in tuiphumna tawh kibang hi. Upna hanga thahna thuakte sisan in tui a kiphum nai keileh ama a din | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism of desire | Baptism of Desire | noun | Tui kiphum nopna. RC sunga Pasian thuthuk a kan pawlkhat in tui kiphum nopna in tuiphumna tawh kikim hi, ci hi. Tua banga Pasian thuthuk duhna leh deihna pen tuiphumna zahin thupi hi, ci hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism of jesus | Baptism of Jesus | noun | Zeisu tui kiphumna. Nasep a kipat ding ciangin Zeisu in Jordan gun ah Johan tungtawn in tui kiphum hi (Mt.3:16-17; Mk.1:9-11; Lk.3:21-22). Khazih tui kiphumna sungah Pa Pasian omna leh Khasiangtho omn | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism of the spirit | Baptism of the Spirit | noun | Khalam tuiphumna. Tapidawte sungah khalam tuiphumna updan nam nih om hi. Tuiphumna pen pumkhat suahna hi. Khasiangtho in Pasian tawh pumkhat hong suaksak hi. Khasiangtho in mihingte lungsim ah upna ho | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, adult | Baptism, Adult | noun | Uliante bek tuiphumna. Tapidawte sungah tuiphumna thu ngaihsutna kilamdang hi. Naungekte nangawn tuisawp in, tuitheh in, tuileih in Pasian mi suakta hi a ci zong om hi. Tuiphumna pen sia leh pha khent | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, believers’ | Baptism, Believers’ | noun | A umte tui kiphumna. Kam tawh upna pulakte bek tuiphumna hi. Thukhun Thak ah Pasian ka um hi a cite bek tui kiphum hi. Tuiphum pawlpi in upna neite bek tuiphum hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, faith | Baptism, Faith | noun | Upkhit teh tuiphumna. Thukhun Thak ah mi khat a pianthak ciangin tui kiphum hi. Pentecost Ni in mi 3000 piangthak in tui kiphum uhhi. Kumcin cianga tuiphumna omlo in pianthak zawh cianga tuiphumna bek | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, john’s | Baptism, John’s | noun | Johan tuiphumna. Tuiphumpa Johan in Jordan gun sungah Zeisu nasep a kipat ding ciangin tui na phum hi (Mt.3:1-12). | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, lay | Baptism, Lay | noun | Mi mawkmawkte tuiphumna. Pawlpi leh kipawlna pan theihpihna ngahlo a mi mawkmawk khat in midangte tui a phumna hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptism, mode of | Baptism, Mode of | noun | Tuiphum zia. Zeisu in nungzuite tungah ama thu a umte tuiphum ding vaikhak banah Zeisu mahmah tui kiphum hi. Ahi zongin tulai thuzuite sungah tuiphum zia a tuamtuam om hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptismal | baptismal | adjective | tuiphumna  kituiphumna  tui kiphuumna  Christian biakna sungah a luut nuamte’n a luut nading pawlpite ciin danin tui kiphuumna nei masa-in, tua zawh ciangin pawlpi mi picing khat suak thei pan hi Bapt | Dr. Dal Lian Haokip |
| baptismal formula | Baptismal Formula | noun | Tui kiphumte zuih ding. Tuiphumna pen pelh theih hilo hi. Tui kiphum ciangin Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian min lawh ding hi. Tui kiphum ciangin Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kong phum hi,  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptismal regeneration | Baptismal Regeneration | noun | Tuiphumna tawh pianthakna. Tuiphumna tawh pianthakna kingah in Pasian ta kisuak hi, cihna hi a, piangthakte in hih bangin sanglo hi. Piangthakte in up khitteh tuiphumna in zui cih pom gige hi. Ahang i | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptismal renewal | Baptismal Renewal | noun | Hong thaksuaksak tuiphumna. Naungek lai a tui kiphum, kitheh khin a, gol cianga tui kiphumkikna in hong nosuaksak hi. Tua banah gol cianga tui kiphumna in i lungsim hong nosuaksak hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptismal service | Baptismal Service | noun | Tuiphum hun. Tui kiphumna in biakpiakna mah hi in, phatna leh biakna kinei hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| baptismal vows | Baptismal Vows | noun | Kiciamna. Naungekte tui kitheh ding cianga nu leh pate kiciamna leh a golte tui kiphum ding cianga Pasian mai ah siapa tungtawn a kiciamna hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| christianity and culture | Christianity and Culture | noun | Tapidaw upna leh ngeina. Upna leh ngeina kizopna ah ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Tapidaw upna in Pasian kammal tawh piangkhia a, ngeina in mihingte tung pan piangkhia hi. Pasian kammal kikhel theilo in  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| christocentric | Christocentric | noun | Khazih bulphuh. Singkhuam tunga Zeisu sihna in hotkhiatna bulpi hi. Zeisu sihna a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi. Vantung gam tunna dingin lampi tuamtuam omlo in, Zeisu bek vantung lampi hi. Khazih | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| christocentrism | Christocentrism | noun | Khazih tungah kilamna. Tapidawte upna bulpi in Khazih leh a thuhilhna tungah kilam hi. Tapidawte in Khazih nungzuite hi. Khazih in upna a piangsakpa leh a kicingsakpa hi (Heb.12:1-2). Tapidaw upna in  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| christology | Christology | noun | Khazih thu sutna. Zeisu pen Pasian leh mihing hi. Mihing khat tungah hih pianngei nih omkhawm hi. Pasian ahihna leh mihing ahihna tawh hong sepsak khempeuh sutna hi. Khazih in mawhneite a dingin sih d | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| christology from above | Christology from Above | noun | Khazih Pasian ahihna. Zeisu pen a om tawntung Pasian hi in, Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a nihnapa hi. Pasian ahihna genna hi (Jn.1:1). | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| christology from below | Christology from Below | noun | Khazih mihing hihna. Zeisu in mawhneite honkhia dinga hong pai ahih manin leitung ah a om sungin mihing hihna a dim in nei hi. Zeisu pen Pasian bek hilo in mihing hihna a dim in nei hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| council of chalcedon | Council of Chalcedon | noun | Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 4 veina kimuhkhopna hi. Hih kimuhkhopna ah Zeisu pen Pasian hilo hi a ci Arius hilhna, Arianism, nial uhhi. Apollinarianism in Zeisu pen mihing taktak ahihna nial ahih manin | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council of constance | Council of Constance | noun | Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 16 vei kimuhkhopna hi (1414-18). Hih kimuhkhopna ah John Wycliffe hilhna maanlo 45 kinial in, John Hus hilhna maanlo 30 zong kithalnial hi. Hih kimuhkhopna ah RC popete zong | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council of constantinople (i,ii,iii) | Council of Constantinople (I,II,III) | noun | Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate nih veina, nga veina leh guk veina kimuhkhopna hi. Constantinople I (381) in Council of Nicea I (325) thukhenna kipsak in, Apollinarianism nial in, Khasiangtho pen Pasian ahih | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council of ephesus | Council of Ephesus | noun | Efesa ah kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 3 vei (431) kimuhkhopna hi. Nestorius in Zeisu pen khat hilo in nih hi. Zeisu tungah Pasian hihna leh mihing hihna omlo in mi nih hi, ci ahih manin hih upna zong ni | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council of nicea (i,ii) | Council of Nicea (I,II) | noun | Nicea ah kikhopna. Tapidaw masate khatveina leh sagih veina kimuhkhopna hi. Nicea I (325) in Zeisu pen Pasian hilo hi a ci Arius’ hilhna maanlo nial in, Zeisu pen Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah khat hi  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council of trent | Council of Trent | noun | Kitukkalhna piang. Tapidaw masate 19 vei (1545-1563) kimuhkhopna hi. Hih hun in RC in thunei a, pianpih mawhna, dikkisakna, RC upna bulpi 7, nekkhawm, biakpiakna (RC missa), kha kholna (purgatory), ki | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| council, general | Council, General | noun | Kikhopna tuamtuamte. A hunhun in mun tuamtuam ah tapidaw upna laigil tawh kilehbulh upna maanlo om ahih manin tuate dona ding leh hilhciatna dingin thuzui pawlkhat in kimuhkhopna nei in upna laigil ka | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| councilor | council | noun | kaunsil a kihel mi | Pu Thang Khan Dal |

| counsel of god | Counsel of God | noun | Pasian vaihawmna. Leitung a thupiangte leh na khempeuh in ama thu a piang hilo in Pasian vaihawmna tawh piang hi. Pasian in na khempeuh thei hi. Pasian theihloh a piang bangmah omlo hi. Pasian thuneih | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| counselor | counsel / counselor / omdan, gamtatdan, tawndan ding thu a hilhtu, a geenpihtu | n / noun | ngaih sutna pia mi upadi mipil(sitni) | Dr. Dal Lian Haokip, Pu Thang Khan Dal, ZomiDict |

| covenant community | Covenant Community | noun | Pasian mite. Langpangte sungah pawlkhat in naungek tuisawpna leh naupang tuiphumna pen tanglai Israelte vun-atna mah bangin Pasian innkuanpih suahna leh Pasian mi hihna lahna ci uhhi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant nation | Covenant Nation | noun | Teeltuam minam. Israelte in Abraham tungtawn in Pasian teeltuam leh Pasian mite hi (Pian.17:1-19). Pasian in ama thu a mangte leh thukham a zuite tungah thupha a tuam in pia hi. Israelte in Pasian tee | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant of grace | Covenant of Grace | noun | Hehpihna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, Pasian in mawhnei mihingte hong khualna leh hotkhiatna hi. Mihingte in mawhna sungah i puk ciangin Pasian in ama hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna lampi hong honsak hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant of redemption | Covenant of Redemption | noun | Tatkhiatna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, hotkhiatna ngahna dingin Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah Tapa Zeisu in mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak hi. Pasian leh mite tawntung kiciamna sungah Tapa  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant of works | Covenant of Works | noun | Sepna tawh dikna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, Pasian in Adam leh Eve tungah sepna leh thumanna tawh nuntak tawntungna ngahna ding leh thumanlohna in sihna piansak ding cihzong gen hi. Eden huan sun | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant people | Covenant People | noun | Teeltuam mipawl. Pasian in Abraham suan leh khakte tungah thupha pia in, ka mite leh ka teeltuamte ci a, tua banah Zeisu upna hangin tapidawte zong Pasian teeltuamte leh Pasian mihonte sungah kihel hi | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant relationship | Covenant Relationship | noun | A cituam kizopna. Pasian in ama thupiak a zuite tungah a cituam kizopna leh ciaptehna pia hi. Pasian thukham zuihna ah thupha om hi. Zeisu a umte in Pasian tawh a cituam kizopna nei hi. Mi khat a pian | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant renewal | Covenant Renewal | noun | A thaksuah kiciamna. Thuzuite in nisim in Pasian tawh kizopna thaksuahsak ding hi. Nekkhawm i zat ciangin Pasian tawh i kizopna thaksuak hi. Eite upna nisim in thaksuahsak ding hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| covenant theology | Covenant Theology | noun | Kiciamna paksakte upna. Kamciamna tunga kinga upna hi. Reformed upna laigil pen hi in, a kamciamte a tangtunna dinga Pasian nasepte kimu hi. (1) Mawhneite kihotkhiatna pen Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian in | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| criticism, canonical | Criticism, Canonical | noun | Laisiangtho sunga kihelte omzia sutna. Laisiangtho sunga kihel ding laibu leh laimalte omzia limtak in kikantel masa hi. Mun khat leh mun khat kizopna om dimdiam in kitukkalhna leh kilehbulh cihte oml | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| divine presence | Divine Presence | noun | Pasian ompihna. Pasian in a bawlsa nate leh mihingte tawh omkhawm hi. Pasian pen mun khempeuh a om Pasian ahih hangin vantung pek a om danin kingaihsun hi. Pasian in eite hong ompih in, a gamlapi ah o | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| doctrine of angels | Doctrine of Angels | noun | Vantungmite thu sutna. Vantungmite in Pasian piansak hi. Amaute in pumpi neilo in kha pumpi bek nei hi.Vantungmi tampi om a, khang theilo leh kiam theilo hi. Vantungmite in Pasian tate huh hi. Vantung | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of bible | Doctrine of Bible | noun | Laisiangtho thu sutna. Laisiangtho in Pasian humopna tawh kigelh ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna neilo hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian kammal hi. Pasian in a kammal tawh eite tungah thu hong gen hi. Lai | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of christ | Doctrine of Christ | noun | Khazih thu sutna. Khazih in pianngei nih: Pasian leh mihing pianngei, nei hi. Khazih in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a nihnapa hi. Khazih in na khempeuh piangsak hi. Khazih in na khempeuh thei hi. Mih | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of church | Doctrine of Church | noun | Saptuam thu sutna. Saptuam in thuzuite hi. Zeisu in saptuam pankhia hi. Piter tungah Pasian in saptuam lamlo hi. Saptuam pen Israel tawh kilamdang hi. Saptuam pen Pentecost Ni in Jerusalem ah kipan hi | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of god | Doctrine of God | noun | Pasian thu sutna. Pasian in na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian hi. Pasian pen siangtho in mawhna neilo hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah Pa bangin om hi. Pasian pen vangliatna khempeuh tawh kidim hi. Pasian | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of holy spirit | Doctrine of Holy Spirit | noun | Khasiangtho thu sutna. Khasiangtho in Pasian hi. Mit tawh kimu theilo hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a thumnapa hi. Kipatna leh tawpna neilo hi. Na khempeuh a piangsakpa leh mawhneite lungsim ah upn | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of last things | Doctrine of Last Things | noun | Hun nung thu sutna. Tuni in hehpihna ni hi. A sawtlo in hih hun bei ding hi. Misiangthote a la dingin meitung pan lei ah Zeisu hong paikik ding hi. Misiangtho kilakna ah a piangthakte kihel dinga, mei | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of man | Doctrine of Man | noun | Mihing thu sutna. Pasian in ama lim leh mel sunin mihing bawl hi. Pasian in leivui leh ama hu gawmkhawm in mihing bawl hi. Adam tung pan numei, Eve, bawl leuleu hi. Pasian in Adam leh Eve tungah khang | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of salvation | Doctrine of Salvation | noun | Hotkhiatna thu sutna. Mi khempeuh Pasian mai ah mawhcip in Pasian gal kisuak hi (Rom 3:23). Mawhneite a honkhia dingin leitung ah Zeisu hong pai hi (Lk.19:10). Zeisu in mawhneite tang dingin sihna thu | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| doctrine of sin | Doctrine of Sin | noun | Mawhna thu sutna. Pasian in ama lim leh mel sunin Adam piangsak hi. Ahi zongin mawhna sungah hong pukcip ciangin Pasian tawh kikhen hi. Adam mawhna eite tungah nu leh pate tungtawn in hong kilawhsuk h | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |

| salvation by faith | Salvation by Faith | noun | Upna tawh hotkhiatna. Upna tawh hotkhiatna kingah in sepna kihello hi. Abraham in sepna kihello in upna tawh dikna ngah hi. Upna in Pasian hehpihna tawh kingah hi. Pasian in upna hong piak ciangin upn | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation by grace | Salvation by Grace | noun | Hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna. Langpangte upna laigil hi a, Pasian hehpihna bek tawh hotkhiatna kingah in, mawhna kol pan kisuakta hi. Pasian in a khawnkhong in hotkhiatna hong pia hi. Hih hotkhiatna in ta | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation by observance of the law | Salvation by Observance of the Law | noun | Thukham zuihna tawh hotkhiatna. Pasian hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna ngah ding ollua ahih manin thukham zuihna bek tawh a bucing hotkhiatna kingah ding hi. Sepna bek tawh dikna kingah hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation by works | Salvation by Works | noun | Sepna tawh hotkhiatna. Hotkhiatna pen upna leh hehpihna tawh hilo in sepna bek tawh kingah hi. Saptuam masate sungah Pelagius in hih bangin hilhna maanlo hilh hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from cultural influences | Salvation from Cultural Influences | noun | Ngeina pan suahtakna. Zeisu hotkhiatna in ngeina hoihlo leh khanglui upna tuamtuam pan suahtakna hi. Mihingte ngeina sungah Pasian thu tawh a kilehbulh tampi om hi. Zeisu hotkhiatna in kha bek hotkhia | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from death | Salvation from Death | noun | Sihna pan hotkhiatna. Hotkhiatna in sihna pan hotkhiatna hi. Sihna in mawhna thaman hi. Pasian tawh kikhenna in sihna hi. Pasian a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah a, Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh in tawnt | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from hell | Salvation from Hell | noun | Gawtmun pan hotkhiatna. Pasian in ama thu a umlote tunna ding gawtmun, meilipi, bawl hi. Zeisu in hih gawtmun pan hong honkhia hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from satan | Salvation from Satan | noun | Satan khutsung pan hotkhiatna. Satan khutsung tungsa mawhnei leitung mite a honkhia dingin Zeisu hong pai in mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak hi. Zeisu in Satan khutsung pan hong honkhia hi. Hot | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from sin | Salvation from Sin | noun | Mawhna pan hotkhiatna. Adam hanga mawhna sung a tung mihingte a honkhia dingin Zeisu in singkhuam tungah sihna hong thuak hi. Mawhna khempeuh Zeisu in hong puaksak hi. Zeisu hangin i mawhna khempeuh m | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation from the law | Salvation from the Law | noun | Thukham pan suahtakna. Pasian in mite hoihna dingin thukham pia hi. Ahi zongin thukham zuizo omlo hi. Zeisu in thukham kalhna khempeuh hong sepsak ahih manin eite sep ding leh zuih ding om nawnlo hi.  | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
| salvation history | Salvation History | noun | Hotkhiatna thu. Leitung mite mawhna pan a honkhia dinga Zeisu hong sihna thu upna panin mawhneite in Pasian hehna pan suakta in Pasian gam tung hi. Hotkhiatna in mihingte sep hilo in Pasian sep hi. | Dr. Mang Cin Pau Gualnam |
